title: SYNERGIES FROM THE MERGER
description: A key strategic development during the year was the initiation of the consolidation of the two major Haldiram’s entities - Haldiram Snacks Private Limited (commonly known as the Noida/Delhi Company) and the Haldiram Snacks Foods International Pvt. Ltd. (referred to as the Nagpur Company).
This ongoing merger is set to pave the way for bigger, stronger and agile FMCG brand that is going to be unique in scale, offerings and customer reach.

synergies.title: Process Standardization
synergies.description: Streamlined operations and improved efficiency across both entities.

synergies.title: Expanded Market Reach
synergies.description: Cross-selling of products across the combined territories of both entities.

synergies.title: Reduced Competition
synergies.description: Mitigation of intra-brand competition in overlapping markets, both domestically and internationally.

synergies.title: Improved Human Resources
synergies.description: Enhanced talent pool and improved resource allocation.

synergies.title: Enhanced Quality Control
synergies.description: Consistent quality standards across all products.

synergies.title: Increased Purchasing Power
synergies.description: Leveraging the combined scale of the merged entity for improved procurement and cost optimization.
